widgets.repair.question: Repair PlxNative’s sandbox?
widgets.repair.body: Use Homebrew Channel’s root access to update PlxNative’s sandbox with LG’s native profile. This requires a rooted TV. Close and reopen PlxNative afterward.

widgets.repair.unsupported: Sandbox repair is not available on this device.
